statement: On fast-aliased seed 119, anchor-direct omega-multistart (DROP the IA Cloud Cross/q_b; multistart an omega-dir x |omega| grid at each cloud q_a rep, rank by coarse-K full-LC surrogate RMSE, polish top-K over the s106 A->C window) RECOVERS TRUTH BLIND and hi-fi-confirmed: winner rep 192 at q0 2.27deg, omega-dir 1.64deg, |omega| 1.5022 deg/s, hi-fi-rho 1.534 Band A -- the first fully-blind hi-fi-confirmed Band A on this seed (s106 was oracle+surrogate, s107 blind tries were hi-fi Band D, s108 blind path was 100x over budget). 26 surrogate Band A+B attractors, 0 phantoms; hi-fi confirms 6/6 A+B (surr-rho matches hifi-rho to ~0.05). The LC PINS OMEGA (all A+B within omega-dir 2.67deg, |omega| 0.005 dps of truth) but leaves ATTITUDE MULTI-VALUED into two families -- near-truth (q0 2.3-21deg) and near the body-X-twin ATTITUDE (q0 3-14deg) -- NONE of which are exact body-twins (a twin carries R_180x.omega, ~154deg from truth omega; every solution carries ~truth omega). COST UNSOLVED: the cheap two-stage rep-prune drops the truth-NEAREST rep (1118/2000) so rep-discrimination needs a dense per-rep omega-grid; basin-catching single-stage is ~97 min/seed (run came in 31.8 min) -- over the 15-min target. SCOPE: N=1 (seed 119), oracle_clean=false (cached cloud + truth LABELS).
